caption: The drawing consists of a square section centered on a larger, otherwise plain, rectangular background. The square contains detailed and light pencil sketches of intricate patterns that resemble embroidery or textile designs. The patterns include repeating motifs such as leaves, flowers, and diamond shapes arranged in diagonal and vertical orientations. The left side and lower portions of the square are filled with symmetrical floral and leafy designs, while the upper and right portions show a net-like diamond pattern, with a smooth transition between these sections along a gentle arc. The entire image is rendered using light, fine pencil lines on an off-white or beige paper. No vivid colors or harsh contrasts are present; the drawing is monochromatic in dreary tones, providing just enough contrast to discern the detailed line work. There are no human figures, animals, or distinct objects other than the decorative patterns.
title: Quilt
